scripts.test: npm run build && npm run validate && npm run gen && cd gen/quicktype && go test ./... && cd ../example-quicktype && go test ./... && cd ../example-oapi-codegen && go test ./... && cd .. && python3 scripts/compare.py
scripts.build: tsp compile . && python3 scripts/seal_additional_properties.py && python3 scripts/fill_inherited_stubs.py && python3 scripts/apply_int_bounds.py && python3 scripts/prune_unused_schemas.py && python3 scripts/flatten_discriminated_unions.py && python3 scripts/annotate_composites.py && python3 scripts/publish_openapi.py
scripts.gen:quicktype: python3 scripts/openapi_to_jsonschema.py && npx quicktype -s schema -l go --package maxapi --just-types-and-package --omit-empty --no-combine-classes -t MaxBotAPI -o gen/quicktype/models.go gen/max.schema.json && python3 scripts/finalize_go_models.py
scripts.gen:oapi-codegen: npm run install:tools && oapi-codegen -config gen/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen.yaml openapi.MaxBotApi.yaml && cd gen/oapi-codegen && go build ./... && go test ./...
scripts.gen: npm run gen:quicktype && npm run gen:oapi-codegen
